description: Combine, transform and undo edits on the selection.

identity.goal: Complete the edit selection use case of vectorcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the vectorcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `vectorcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced vectorcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `vectorcraft_select_tool`, `vectorcraft_pathfinder`, `vectorcraft_transform`, `vectorcraft_undo`, `vectorcraft_redo`. Steps: (1) Select the target objects. (2) Combine and transform them. (3) Step back or forward through the undo history. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace vectorcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
